scope: Branch/Tag native captured creation, shared Switch handoff and deferred description recovery. Full application port remains incomplete.

verification.core: Six focused ReferenceCreationTests passed. Actual reference/config effects establish deferred description timing, foreign-lock preservation and description-only recovery, CR stripping/trimming, whitespace removal, absent removal, unchanged reference SHA. Other existing tests cover branches, tags, force, signing guards, tracking, cross-name and invalid refs. Not a full suite rerun.
verification.native: Final four-Git receiver passed real shared Switch models: branch created before checkout, description absent until acknowledgement; successful checkout then normalized description; failed checkout exposes Stash/Retry/SwitchWithMerge and retains created ref/working bytes, then description after acknowledgement. Foreign config lock inserted after checkout preserves ref/lock and retries captured description only, without recreating/checking out. Production-style presenter with Switch unchecked writes description; force plus whitespace removes old config without switching. Production-style tag path captures Push/name/message through cross-name Continue and later edits, and unchecked Push remains unchecked. Explicit HEAD/load/duplicate/late invalidation guards, hidden options hosting and hidden controller close/Quit guard checks passed. No actual Push/network or visible UI.
verification.regression: Final four-Git RefLog revision-handoff receiver passed immutable selected hash into real Branch/Tag, browser and Export models, no auto-create/export, chooser and missing/multi/invalid/busy/stash/parent guards; HEAD/refs/index/config/worktree invariants unchanged.
verification.source_notes: Pinned CAppUtils::CreateBranchTag creates the ref, performs Switch if requested, then writes raw-nonempty branch description, including after failed Switch; Tag Push uses full ref. UpdateBranchDescription strips CR/trims and unsets whitespace-empty values. Native shared Switch retains existing recovery/icons/close policy, with options owned behind sheet instead of upstream closed modal. Explicit description failure/retry improves source ignored config return. Legacy callers without presenter retain old behavior and incomplete partial-failure recovery. Creation itself has no source CProgress; shared policy applies to Switch only.
